challenges.text: Injuries were caused in exercise of private defence, not aggression
Medical report does not corroborate victim's version of assault
Weapon allegedly used was never recovered from accused
Incident occurred during sudden fight - no premeditation
Injuries are simple, not grievous - IPC 325 not applicable
No intention to kill - vital parts were not targeted
Bystander testimony is inconsistent with medical evidence
CCTV footage does not show accused causing injuries
